## Plugin reference

- Description: Contributes the sonata icon family (sonataIcons) to Icons.Family, so a scope whose iconFamily is sonata — the Sonata theme's — draws its glyphs.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `Icons.Family` "Sonata"
  - Uses: `ui/icons.Icons`
- Core:
  - Uses: `ui/icons.defineIconFamily`
  - Exports (types): `SonataGlyph`
  - Exports (values): `sonataIcons`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/sonata/audio/metronome`
    - `apps/sonata/notation`
    - `apps/sonata/piano-roll`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/chord-progression`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/chord-readout`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/circle-of-fifths`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/key-readout`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/swing`
    - `apps/sonata/sources/ultimate-guitar`
